argv:
set -eu
npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
export CI=true NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
for command in frozen-regression-replay; do
 echo "COMMAND_BEGIN:$command"
 set +e
 npm run test -- src/__tests__/LocalFontContract.test.ts
 code=$?
 set -e
 echo "COMMAND_EXIT:$command:$code"
 test "$code" -eq 0 || exit "$code"
done
du -sk /tmp/work
 df -k /tmp
scope: local bounded lint/type/unit image portability; no full/native acceptance
